slots.title: Bitcoin stolen from Binance tops Tesla’s holdings and is over twice El Salvador’s reserve
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The 18,270 BTC haul is worth about $1.4 billion and comes within 442 coins of SpaceX’s disclosed holdings. Blockchain investigators link the attack to North Korea.

slots.title: Experts divided over Binance hack asset freezes, warn recovery is another matter
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Tether, Circle and others moved within hours to block billions in stolen crypto, but legal experts question whether smaller victims would get the same protection.

slots.title: OpenAI reportedly cuts fundraising and valuation targets amid AI jitters
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Anxiety about the AI boom has sent the Nasdaq 100 slumping by about 10% in just three weeks since hitting a record high on October 6, including a 4.5% drop on Friday.

slots.title: Nvidia weighs playing the cosigner for Nscale’s AI data center in West Virginia
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: When investors get nervous about AI spending, it helps to have the chipmaker that sells the chips offer to cosign the loan.
